title: Review of c18's Flow-Lenia starve-one-daughter claim (IMED): on fresh seeds 8 and 9 the gliders divide (generation 4 and 8) and travel 7.6-12.4 body lengths, and the daughter whose food is cut dissolves ~230 t after the fork while its sister and its fed twin live on
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged with labkit on fresh seeds 8 and 9 (128^2, t=800) and c18's dfork.py on the same seeds. Packs: one noise patch gives 10-13 crescent gliders, 7 and 14 persistent splits, generation 4 and 8, merge/split 0.69 and 0.76, max 12.4 and 7.6 body lengths. Forks (seed 8 at t=245, pair 19 px apart, masses 106/50; seed 9 at t=150, 27.5 px, 74/90): in the cut run the starved daughter stops, shrinks and is gone by t~475 (seed 8) and t~380 (seed 9), while its sister glides on, grows (to 323 and 185-380) and divides; in the fed twins the same daughter keeps gliding and grows or divides (forks/df8.png, df9.png). Ledger drift <= 3e-12.

observations.I: rerun/seed8/sheet.png: discrete crescent gliders of bounded size
observations.M: rerun/seed8/FACTS.md: 26 tracks moved >= 1 body length, max 12.4; seed 9 max 7.6
observations.E: forks/df8.png, df9.png: starved daughter (+) dissolves by ~230 t after the fork; sister (x) grows and divides; fed twin daughter persists
observations.D: rerun/seed9/lineage.png: 14 persistent splits, generation 8; seed 8: 7, generation 4

controls_run.E: forks/df8.png, df9.png (dfork.py: fed twin vs food cut in a disk following one daughter, from the same fork state)

by_construction: E (matter is built only from food and decays back into it)
verdicts.limitation: Genealogy is reticulate (merge/split 0.69-0.76), so D confidence stays medium. The trackers lose bodies at merges, so tracked masses jump; I judged from the images. In the seed 9 fed twin the tracked daughter is lost by the tracker at t~390 after a merge, so its fate after that is not followed. Planted founders (one noise patch), so no S.
